TC-API-AUTH-001.summary: Owner login returns a valid JWT and user profile
howToRun: POST /api/auth/login with owner email/password from fixtures/personas.json.
Assert HTTP 200 and a token in the response body.
Token is cached for subsequent cases in the same run.

expected.behavior: JWT issued; user can call authenticated APIs.

whatToFix: Login must return HTTP 200 with a JWT for the owner persona.
howToFix: Confirm user exists in LiteDesk tenant
